## Implementation
The authenticated shell now forwards scoped system.license simulation events with negative event IDs to the renderer without advancing durable WebSocket resume/seen state. The app uses their full licence payload; normal positive-ID events retain the GET /meta/license refresh path. A licence reason change no longer restarts the polling effect and erases a socket-scoped state. Files: electron/event-cursor.cjs, electron/main.cjs, src/App.tsx, src/i18n.ts. Contract snapshot: contracts/backend-fix-refresh-2026-10-23.json.

## Real DEV checks
npm run build PASS (mandatory help/TypeScript/Vite); npm test 48 PASS; node scripts/backend-fix-check.mjs 5 PASS on real DEV run DEMO-BACKEND-FIX-1792725252354; npm run test:foundation 14 PASS on the same renderer/native source. Sanitized journal artifacts/backend-fix-passed-20261023.json; screenshots artifacts/backend-license-grace.png, backend-license-grace-ur-250.png, backend-critical-toast.png. Actual socket grace, locked and ok restore events persisted through route navigation. The real socket reconnected with positive resume cursors 444 and 445; negative IDs were never sent as resume_from. An existing valid token remained usable in locked simulation. After the actual native scheduled refresh callback received locked403, the shell cleared the session and showed Login/licence refusal. EN/UR dark/high contrast 250% captured.

## Limits
Only tested rubric items listed. DEV licence simulation was scoped to the owned session and did not change global licensing. Named human fresh-data journey, full role FAQ/Urdu review, real licensing transition outside the fixture and whole-screen acceptance remain pending. Proposal grants no points until human review.
